rationale: The description identifies content discovery and recommendations, but does not state how recommendations are produced or establish AI. The non_ai judgment is therefore weak and forced.
evidence_spans: AppFlash is a content discovery service, which uses the power of your smartphone to make your life easier by giving you app, movie, music, and restaurant recommendations all in one place.
conflict_response: Both proposals appropriately retain weak, forced non_ai. The recommendation feature could be AI-dependent, but the exact description does not specify its method, so AI cannot be inferred; likewise, the absence of an AI signal cannot support a non-forced negative. Keep the binary judgment weak/forced and leave subtype fields null.
